name: David McAllister - Considérant AJ - Am 64
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: AJ. whereas the EU has a historic opportunity to deepen its alliance with Latin America; whereas the political and cooperation pillar of the EU-Mercosur Partnership Agreement requires the approval of Parliament, the Council and the national parliaments of the Member States; whereas the trade pillar requires the approval of Parliament and the Council only; whereas the provisional application of the interim Trade Agreement prior to Parliament giving its consent would go against the spirit of the Framework Agreement1a, the principle of sincere cooperation among institutions and the Commission’s repeated commitments not to propose provisional application before Parliament gives its consent; whereas concerns remain regarding its potentially negative impact on EU sustainability and safety standards and on the competitiveness of the EU agri-food sector; whereas the agreement will set up an institutional framework to foster cooperation in areas such as human rights, sustainable development, the digital economy and combating organised crime; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Framework Agreement on relations between the European Parliament and the European Commission, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/agree\_interinstit/2010/1120/2018-02-07](http://data.europa.eu/eli/agree_interinstit/2010/1120/2018-02-07).
